from calm.hrm_text_158.native_full_stack.lands_ab_eval_fixture_source import DEFAULT_SOURCE_PINS; from calm.hrm_text_158.native_full_stack.lands_ab_eval_schema import GATING_ROWS; run_root=Path(r'/tmp/lands_ab_runtime_scratch/1785244883605-c7c0b0a3/a258f3142e5e9af1/test-operator/<nonce>'); paths={}; [paths.__setitem__(gr, {'path': str(p), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})  for gr in GATING_ROWS for p in [harvest_exactly_one_raw_obs(run_root=run_root, gating_row=gr)]]; man={'raw_artifact_paths': paths, 'required_key_set': None, 'caveats': ['formal packet_v6 consumer; class-aware universe via raw obs; {path,sha256} entries'], 'run_root': str(run_root)}; universes={}; [universes.__setitem__(gr, (json.loads(Path(entry['path']).read_text()).get('key_universe') or json.loads(Path(entry['path']).read_text()).get('row_key_universe') or []))  for gr,entry in paths.items()]; cpu_u=sorted(set(universes.get('G_CPU_STATIC_AB') or [])); cuda_us=[tuple(sorted(set(universes[g] or []))) for g in GATING_ROWS if g.startswith('G_CUDA_')]; assert len(set(cuda_us))==1, 'cuda_row_universe_mismatch_within_class'; req=sorted(set(cpu_u)|set(cuda_us[0])); man['required_key_set']=req; man['row_key_universes']=universes; man_path=Path(r'/tmp/lands_ab_runtime_scratch/1785244883605-c7c0b0a3/a258f3142e5e9af1/test-operator/<nonce>/raw_artifact_manifest.json'); o_excl_write_text(man_path, json.dumps(man, indent=2, sort_keys=True)); receipt=build_eval_receipt_from_raw_artifacts(raw_artifact_paths=man['raw_artifact_paths'], source_pins=dict(DEFAULT_SOURCE_PINS), required_key_set=man['required_key_set'], caveats=man.get('caveats')); out=Path(r'/tmp/lands_ab_runtime_scratch/1785244883605-c7c0b0a3/a258f3142e5e9af1/test-operator/<nonce>/eval_receipt.json'); o_excl_write_text(out, json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True)); print(json.dumps({'branch_id': receipt['reducer_output']['branch_id'], 'science_claim': receipt['science_claim'], 'LANDS_AB': receipt['claim_ceiling']['LANDS_AB'], 'eval_receipt_sha256': hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(man_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'path': str(out), 'manifest_path': str(man_path)}, sort_keys=True))
